title: Charged Frost Spear
description: this is a wand that is easy to make and can shoot tridents, which deals high damage.
body: a all new minecraft weapen that shoots tridents when long click right mouse button(deals 12 damage), and can shoot ice blocks when click left mouse buttonwhich deals 5 damage. It is a decent weapon and cheap, which you only needs blocks of ice and wooden sticks. It still has bugs like it can't deal it's mlee damage. And be patient for these to be fixed.Don't forget to be on the watchout for other mods. Happy playing!(need fabric api)
